bio:
Board-certified orthopaedic surgeon (American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery). Care for joints, bones, muscles and sports injuries: knees, shoulders, hips, back, hands and feet. Video visits now for patients located in Maryland. Our Columbia clinic opens January 1, 2027.

First visits cover your history, an exam (in person) or a guided movement check (by video), and a written plan you leave with: next steps, imaging if needed, and when to follow up. Questions: (737) 365-9355.
